questions.exact_question: Reference-only question for the Leica M10 film study: what enclosure-closure evidence should I look for, and does fitting the cover prove the camera works? Give a short answer from the guide.
questions.exact_answer: For the enclosure closure, look for the visible alignment and fitting of a shell or plate onto the partly assembled camera body, and ensure it covers previously exposed internals. Fitting the cover alone does not prove the camera functions correctly.
